title: Chiyo (RT3)
features:
Full Restaurant Automation – Automatically seats customers, takes orders, cooks food, serves dishes, and cleans tables.
Auto Collect & Manage – Automatically collects all tips and purchases advertising upgrades.
Smart Menu – Automatically sets your menu to only the highest profit dish for maximum earnings.
Auto Boost – Works with Smart Menu to automatically boost your highest profit dish.
Auto Farm & Restock – Automatically farms crops and restocks ingredients from the shop, with an option to auto-buy/farm ingredients needed for your boosted dish.
Auto Claim Rewards – Automatically claims daily login rewards and objective/friendship rewards.
Fast Workers – Makes all your hired NPC workers move at maximum speed.
Discord Webhooks – Get detailed updates on your player profile, live restaurant status, and notifications for claimed rewards.
